summary: @servicetitan/standalone-root 1.11.4 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The 1.11.4 release of this React/MobX data-provider library adds an undocumented preinstall hook (`scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`) grafted onto an otherwise clean library. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-prefixed `_0xNNNNNN` identifiers, per-function string tables). On install it probes for a system `bun` binary and, when absent, downloads a Bun release archive from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...zip`, unzips it, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'], {stdio:'inherit'})` against a sibling 727KB obfuscated file `math_init.js` (sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc, header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, string-array rotator `WV8StW`, packed alphabet decoder `hc1jfK9`). The advertised library entry (`dist/index.js` = `export * from./components/stores/enums`) does not reference setup.mjs or math_init.js, and CHANGELOG.md documents releases only through v1.11.2 — the preinstall harness and payload are undeclared additions in this version. Using an alternate runtime to execute a heavily obfuscated sibling file at install time is an install-time remote-code-execution shape that bypasses Node-focused scanners and runs on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
